Frequently asked questions

The short answers, up front.

Is DocuLocal really free?

Yes. Every tool is free, with no sign-up and no daily task limits. Most online PDF tools cap free accounts at a couple of tasks per day or add watermarks; DocuLocal runs on your own device, so there is no server bill to pass on to you.

Are my files uploaded to a server?

No. All processing happens locally in your browser using the PDF libraries loaded with this page. Your files are never transmitted, stored, or tracked — you can verify this by disconnecting from the internet after the page loads and working as normal.

How is redaction different from drawing a black box?

A black box drawn over text only hides it visually — the text underneath can still be copied out of the file. DocuLocal's redaction re-renders the page from pixels with the black boxes burned in, so the underlying content is permanently removed from the exported PDF.

Can I merge or split PDFs on my phone?

Yes. DocuLocal works in any modern mobile or desktop browser, and it can be installed as an app for quick access. Page reordering, rotation, and deletion are all touch-friendly.

Is an electronic signature from DocuLocal valid?

DocuLocal places a true signature image into the PDF and flattens it into the file. In many jurisdictions a typed or drawn e-signature is legally binding for everyday agreements, but for regulated documents, check your local requirements or consult a professional.

How DocuLocal compares

The big PDF sites are good tools — but they run on their servers, meter your free tasks, and ask for an account. DocuLocal takes the opposite approach.
